text: NBI Serves Subpoena to DPWH Davao Director Amid Flood Control Probe DAVAO CITY The National Bureau of Investigation has served a subpoena to DPWH Davao Regional Director Juby Blancaver Cordon as part of its ongoing investigation into alleged anomalies in flood control projects in Davao Region The subpoena was issued as the NBI looks into reports of irregularities and questionable disbursements tied to flood mitigation works in the area Investigators said Cordon was required to appear before the bureau and submit documents related to project implementation bidding and fund utilization The probe forms part of a wider scrutiny of flood control spending nationwide following public complaints and reports of substandard or incomplete projects despite large budget allocations
